output.reason: [ev-8e78387c2b06] is a single prerequisite bullet in the v2 upgrade guide, "All packages use fully qualified image names", and says nothing else. It doesn't define what counts as fully qualified (for example, whether a registry host is required or which default registry applied before). So it doesn't say which package references are exposed, and an applicability condition can't be written from it. It also doesn't say what happens if a package uses a non-qualified name after the upgrade, such as a failed resolution or pulls from a different registry, so the consequence can't be stated either.
